decisionGap: Readers asking this cannot get the primary-source answer and its conditions on this site; nearest pages answer neighbouring decisions (see whyNewPage in the manifest and coverage.txt).
finding: Investor.gov frames investment management as either your own responsibility, starting from a financial plan, or an investment adviser's ongoing advice and monitoring for a fee typically based on the value of the assets in your account; the SEC's Form ADV bulletin treats the amount of client assets managed (AUM) as a required Part 2A disclosure; Form CRS states that an asset-based fee may cost more than a transaction fee but suits ongoing advice or delegated decisions.
conditions: US readers; securities investment management; no fee figures or regulatory-AUM thresholds asserted beyond the sources read; wealth-management and fee-crossover questions are left to existing pages.
whatWouldChange: A professional who is broker-only (paid per transaction), a balance small enough that an asset-based or subscription fee is a large share, or an SEC change to the disclosure forms.
method: Reported primary-source synthesis; no test or model.
